topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000002605 (log-concavity of the rank numbers of semimodular lattices)
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture2605 concerns log-concavity of Whitney rank numbers of semimodular lattices. Its W rank sequence and stated wording caused an indexed W-state hit; no simple-tensor rank or secant variety.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000000521
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture521 concerns alternating graded Betti sums of edge ideals. Tensoring a resolution with the ground field is unrelated to tensor-rank decomposition. The maintainer rejection corrects ideal I versus quotient R/I Betti tables, not any secant hierarchy claim.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000000521 (v2: ideal Betti numbers)
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture521 v2 corrects the earlier Betti-module convention using the four-cycle ideal. Tensoring resolutions remains unrelated to tensor rank and secant varieties.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000001092
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture1092 constructs a complete cap in the finite projective plane PG(2,27). Its secants are lines used for cap completeness, not secant varieties of the Segre embedding or tensor border rank.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000001433
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture1433 concerns activated random walks and absorption-time decay. The W-state regex hits ordinary prose; the maintainer rejection concerns missing probabilistic content and an unsupported critical sleep-rate premise.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000001760
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture1760 concerns irreducible group-representation degrees versus maximal subgroup index for C2 times A5. Tensoring irreducible characters with a linear character is unrelated to simple-tensor rank or secant hierarchy.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove conjecture 00000000388: Nested threshold classes contradict disjointness
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture388 concerns nested threshold classes W_m and incompatibility of nonemptiness with disjointness. The approval comment addresses that order-theoretic contradiction, not W tensors or secant varieties.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove 00000008251: a complete market has one martingale extreme point
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture8251 concerns extreme martingale probabilities in a complete two-state financial market. The W-state regex matches two states; no tensor-rank or secant-variety claim.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove 00000008341: Jarnik dimension cannot be negative
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture8341 concerns a Jarnik approximation set and nonnegative Hausdorff dimension. The indexed W-state hit refers to the parameter w and stated formula, not a quantum W tensor.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000000438 (primitives of NSym vs Eulerian numbers)
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture438 concerns primitive subspace dimensions in the NSym Hopf algebra and Eulerian numbers. Tensor-square coproduct calculations do not concern minimal simple-tensor decompositions or secant hierarchy.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000003824 (Nakajima monomial crystal M(λ) is B(λ), not ⊕_{μ≤λ} B(μ))
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture3824 concerns Nakajima monomial crystals and highest-weight decompositions. Tensor products of crystals and Clebsch-Gordan decompositions are distinct from tensor-rank/secant-hierarchy classification.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000008975: primitive degree-three reflection solution
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture8975 constructs a degree-three polynomial reflection-equation solution. Kronecker products, the tensor flip, and Yang-Baxter equations do not assert tensor-rank equality with secant indices.
